answer: Here is a specific defense: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the knoll to sunk effort, uses the saffron as an corroborating signal, then requires a spiral before any payout.
